# Expressive Voice 2.0

The app is now **Expressive Voice** (it still shows as **Recorder** under the launcher icon). It installs as an update over the earlier betas.

## New
- **Recording quality setting** — choose Low (64 kbps), Standard (128 kbps, default), High (192 kbps) or Maximum (256 kbps). If the phone can't use a choice, it records at Standard instead of failing.
- **Recordings folder setting** — pick where recordings are saved, with an option to move existing recordings.
- **One-tap recording** — the red Record button on the home screen starts recording immediately; no second page and no second tap. Stopping brings you back to the list.
- **New Record button** — pill-shaped with a press-and-hold animation.
- **Haptic feedback** — a crisp physical-button click on Record, Stop, Play/Pause, −5s and +10s.
- **Scrub timestamp** — while dragging the progress bar, the left time shows exactly where you are in the recording.

## Design
- Settings now use lighter, rounded, grouped containers in the style of Wiki Reader.

## Faster
- Smoother, faster recordings list and scrolling.
- Opening a recording is quicker: waveforms are saved after the first time, prepared in the background for new and recent recordings, and playback is ready as soon as the screen opens.
- Waveform decoding uses far less memory on long recordings.

## Fixed
- Waveform no longer shows flat bars when reopening a recording.

## Under the hood
- Package name stays `com.captechomar.recorder`, signed with the same key, so it updates in place.
